PCX-056.name: GameSync Mod Health
PCX-056.finding: Current source proves that MODHEALTH_RUN_BACKGROUND collects and analyzes evidence directly but does not currently prove an append into the overlay evidence cache. The background job builds and clears a source-URL-shaped evidenceCacheKey, then analyzes allCollected directly, while the overlay owns MODHEALTH_EVIDENCE_APPEND/GET/CLEAR with a game/mod/URL logical key. Background job result/AutoNotes output and overlay cache continuity are therefore separate verified behaviors until a shared canonical key/append path is implemented and exercised.
